confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Havana prices are volatile and often quoted in USD or EUR, with a large gap between tourist and local pricing, so accommodation and drink anchors are least certain. The FX figure came from a search snippet of the RBA homepage and was not checked against the F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Caribbean tourist capitals with limited formal lodging supply and dual local and tourist pricing, adjusted for Cuba's high import costs and scarcity. No single comparable city was used.
